gaps: No release-era English-language press review of Armed Police Batrider was found; Japanese magazine reviews (e.g. Gamest) were not consulted.
GameFan's Soldier Blade percentages were not legible in the scan; Wikipedia's 80%/88% citation is relied on.
Alien Soldier manual is an English edition of unstated translation provenance; mechanics cross-checked against Wikipedia and Mean Machines where possible.
PCSX2 wiki (Cloudflare-blocked) and HG101 live site (maintenance) were not readable; archived/alternative sources used.
No controls, emulator cores, rotation, input lag or performance were tested for this issue.
Soldier Blade US box art: originating scrape service (ScreenScraper or TheGamesDB via ES-DE) was not recorded.
Revision 2 (public edition): personal-library, device and travel framing removed and prose reworked for a general audience; article game references added. Research facts unchanged.
